report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We regret to inform you that your application is not moving forward, as you do not meet several required qualifications: at least 4 years of data science experience, understanding of Bayesian methods or time series analysis, hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (such as Pyro, PyMC3, or JAGS), experience with Amazon SageMaker, experience with PySpark, and strong working knowledge of SQL.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
